# The Drip Theory

> The Drip Theory is a Reddit and LinkedIn marketing agency for B2B SaaS companies. We find the problems a company's ideal customers post about on Reddit, answer them in the right subreddits as the founder, and turn those conversations into LinkedIn posts that build inbound pipeline.

Website: https://www.thedriptheory.com/
Contact: coffee@thedriptheory.com

## Who it is for
- B2B SaaS founders who sell to a clear ideal customer profile (ICP)
- Teams that want inbound demand from Reddit and LinkedIn instead of paid ads

## How it works
1. Figure out the ICP: who buys and what they complain about.
2. Find the threads: map the subreddits and recurring threads where buyers ask for help.
3. Talk as the founder: daily Reddit replies, LinkedIn posts and comments in the founder's voice.
4. One profile, one view: everything runs through one founder profile and one weekly report.

## Services
- Reddit presence: daily replies, weekly threads and reputation monitoring in the subreddits the ICP reads.
- LinkedIn content: three founder posts a week, built from real buyer questions found on Reddit.
- LinkedIn engagement: daily comments on posts by people in the ICP.
- ICP research: ICP profile, subreddit map, pain-point library and competitor mentions.
- AMAs and launches: planned AMAs and launch threads for a one-day spike on top of daily activity.
- Competitor intelligence: monthly report on what users say about competing tools on Reddit.

## Why Reddit and LinkedIn
- Reddit had 130.3 million daily active uniques in Q2 2026, up 18% year over year (Reddit Q2 2026 results).
- Reddit is the most-cited domain in AI search answers; one Semrush sample found 40.1% of citations pointed to Reddit (Semrush, 2025).
- Google and OpenAI both have data agreements with Reddit (2024).
- LinkedIn reported 1.2 billion members (LinkedIn, Microsoft FY25 Q4).
- 73% of B2B decision-makers say thought leadership is a more trustworthy basis for judging a company than its marketing materials (Edelman × LinkedIn, 2024).

## FAQ
- Will this get us banned on Reddit? No fake accounts or vote manipulation. Every reply follows the subreddit's rules and leads with a useful answer.
- Do you post from our accounts? Yes, through the founder's own profile, after the founder approves the voice.
- How are results reported? A weekly report: threads joined, replies, rankings, impressions, profile visits, DMs and demos booked.
- What happens on the first call? A free 30-minute audit and a list of ten threads the company could join that week.
